lines.en: I walk the stone steps of the temple.
I go slowly so as not to crush the moss.
My cloak sweeps the steps and sheds dust.
I patrol along the corridor.

lines.zh: 我去看一眼山下的村子。
lines.en: I go to check the village below.

lines.zh: 我脚下无声，这是练出来的。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; that was trained.

lines.zh: 我停在水缸边，喝了一口。
lines.en: I stop at the water jar and drink.
My hands are tucked into my sleeves.

lines.zh: 台阶上的浮土被我踢开。
lines.en: I kick the loose dust off the step.

lines.zh: 我绕开那块裂了的石板。
lines.en: I step around the cracked slab.
I head back; it will be dark soon.
I count the steps left.
Leaves under my feet, very softly.

lines.zh: 我上台阶时提了一下衣摆。
lines.en: I lift my hem on the steps.

lines.zh: 我在等人，不知道等到何时。
lines.en: I wait for someone, with no idea how long.
I set my hat on my knee.
I stare at the pebbles in the yard.
I sit cross-legged, my back straight.
The wind rings the bell under the eaves.
I pinch the bridge of my nose.

lines.zh: 我在想那些还没解决的问题。
lines.en: I am thinking of problems still unsolved.
The tea went cold; I drank it anyway.
There is a patch on my cloak.

lines.zh: 我把手放在膝上，安静下来。
lines.en: I rest my hands on my knees and go quiet.
Someone is training in the distance.
I listen to my own breathing.
The map on the table has curled edges.
I stir the fire a little brighter.
You're here. Sit.

lines.zh: 你是来学东西的，还是来问路的？
lines.en: Are you here to learn, or just to ask directions?

lines.zh: 我在你的气里看到犹豫。
lines.en: I see hesitation in your ki.
Your wound hasn't healed. Don't push it.
You needn't stand so stiffly.

lines.zh: 把帽子摘了，让我看清你的脸。
lines.en: Take off your hat and let me see your face.

lines.zh: 你手上那层茧是练过的。
lines.en: The calluses on your hands speak of training.

lines.zh: 我看得出你不习惯这里。
lines.en: I can tell you're not used to this place.

lines.zh: 你比上次来的时候稳了。
lines.en: You are steadier than at your last visit.
State your business; I won't wait.
I look up just once.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太响，整座山都听见了。
lines.en: Your steps are so loud the whole mountain hears.
I set down what I was holding.
Cape cast aside. Speak.
Sit and talk; standing tires you.

lines.zh: 你想问的那件事，我未必答。
lines.en: What you want to ask, I may not answer.
I press my shoulder and draw a breath.

lines.zh: 我一个做向导的，也挨了打。
lines.en: A mere guide, and I get struck as well.

lines.zh: 我退到门槛上，稳住身形。
lines.en: I step back to the threshold and steady.
The cloak is torn; I'll mend it later.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，晃了一下。
lines.en: These old bones of mine wobble.
I frown and say nothing.
This wound won't hinder me.
I lean on the pillar and catch my breath.
I'm old; I heal slowly.
There isn't much to offer here.

lines.zh: 你要是带了吃的，就自己留着。
lines.en: If you brought food, keep it.
I'll pour you some water.
I eat very simply.
This only exists down in the village.
What you bring, I won't refuse.

lines.zh: 我掰了一半，剩下的给你。
lines.en: I break it in half and give you the rest.

lines.zh: 不必客气，这是待客之道。
lines.en: No need for thanks; that's hospitality.

lines.zh: 山下带来的，我就尝一口。
lines.en: Something brought up from below; I will taste it.

lines.zh: 你吃你的，我留着慢慢吃。
lines.en: Eat yours; I'll save mine.
I am sturdier than I look.
The steps are slippery. Careful.
I steady you with a hand.
You stepped on my cloak.
I shift half a body's width aside.
You mean no harm; I can see it.
Our shadows overlap on the steps.
I brush off the dust and walk on.

lines.zh: 我这个年纪，已经不想这些。
lines.en: At my age, I no longer think of such things.
You should find someone suited to you.
I owe a great deal in this life.
I have much left unfinished.

lines.zh: 别说这个，我已经很老了。
lines.en: Don't speak of it. I am already old.
Just talk with me; that's enough.
I push the tea toward you.
If you stay, I won't send you off.
But don't think too much.
Someone from the village must have dropped it.
I set it on the stone table.
This is worth little.
I have noted whose this is.

lines.zh: 这东西，我先搁在石桌上。
lines.en: I set this down on the stone table for now.
This fits that gap nicely.
Trash shouldn't be left on the ground.
I pick it up and look it over again.

lines.zh: 你动手，我就不能不管了。
lines.en: If you strike, I cannot stand aside.
I'll give you one chance. Withdraw.
This is not a sparring match. Don't be reckless.
I raise a hand, palm inward.
You'll pay for what you broke.
I sigh and unfasten my cloak.

lines.zh: 你不该在这座山的院子里动手。
lines.en: You shouldn't fight in this temple yard.
My feet are rooted now.
Don't force me to use my strength.
You don't know the rules of this mountain.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，台阶不出声。
lines.en: I follow behind; the steps stay silent.
You cannot reach my vitals.
I am watching your breathing.
You spend your strength too fast.
I angle away from your edge.
There's a gap in your armor.
I don't chase; if you retreat, I wait.
Your legs are shaking.

lines.zh: 我把两指并拢，气聚起来。
lines.en: I bring two fingers together and gather ki.
This palm is light, enough to wake you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，往下一按。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and press down.
My elbow hits your ribs.
I push you back into the courtyard.
The beam grazes past you.
I sweep a foot and trip you.
This palm is only to sober you up.
Your guard is not bad.
I dislike hitting hard.
You fall back; I don't pursue.

lines.zh: 我从神殿的门后走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind the temple door.
The wind is strong here; hold the cloak.

lines.zh: 我落脚时石阶响了一声。
lines.en: The step creaks under my landing.
More people than usual today.
I close the door and drop the bar.
I look up; the clouds hang low.
The mountain is quiet.
I'll check the water jar first.
A guest waits below.
I straighten my collar.
Fire catches my cuff; I smother it.

lines.zh: 从台阶上摔下去，腰闪了。
lines.en: I fell down the steps and wrenched my back.
A corner of the steps is blown away.

lines.zh: 箭钉在门框上，离我很近。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the frame, very near me.
Spell-light smothers my ki.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃饭，肚子在抗议。
lines.en: I forgot to eat; my stomach protests.
Lightning strikes the roof bell.
The steps beneath me vanish.
